cover: Global Tech Outages, Political Fallout, and High-Stakes Diplomacy Reshape International Affairs
cover_scene: A glowing digital network globe illuminated in red warning lights, surrounded by international flags and silhouettes of government domes.

slides.scene: A dimly lit Congressional hearing room with empty witness microphones positioned in front of a glowing microchip schematic.
slides.headline: Nvidia CEO Resigns Amid China Chip Inquiry
slides.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned abruptly following reports linking an executive at a partner firm to Chinese intelligence. U.S. lawmakers have summoned tech executives to testify regarding semiconductor export controls and potential chip smuggling to Beijing.

slides.scene: A grand European diplomatic hall overlooking a rainy garden, featuring American and European flags positioned beside a central meeting table.
slides.headline: EU Secures Voice in Ukraine Peace Talks
slides.body: European leaders debated their role in upcoming Ukraine-Russia peace negotiations after U.S. envoys met with Vladimir Putin and Volodymyr Zelensky. Diplomatic officials confirmed European delegates will participate in the next trilateral summit.

slides.scene: A submerged tent city under heavy rain, flooded pathways winding between makeshift shelters under gray storm clouds.
slides.headline: Severe Flooding Worsens Humanitarian Crisis in Gaza
slides.body: Torrential rainfall destroyed over 70,000 tents across Gaza, killing at least six people and displacing hundreds of thousands. Local authorities warn that extreme weather combined with ongoing political stalemates is worsening humanitarian conditions.

slides.scene: A dark voting hall with an empty wooden ballot box illuminated by a single overhead light.
slides.headline: South Africa's ANC Suffers Record Electoral Defeat
slides.body: South Africa's ruling African National Congress secured under 31 percent of the vote in local government elections, marking its worst result since 1994. Voters turned away from the party due to widespread frustration over failing public services.
